author: Arachadonic
body:
I was playing Nebula on Crescent when suddenly my minecraft started chomping up memory and lagging a bit. Then I turned around and saw this just as I died and the game ended. So I moved closer and sure enough it turns out that this map is not in a void world. It was just made seem like that which is why I lag. Please fix it. 

Note also that the nearer I got my minecraft actually stopped responding so I am lucky the screenshot actually took. Just look at all the running lava/water...
Thanks.

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: I had the same Issue on my maps. I think its a bug from the emptyworldgenerator plugin, because I only had this when I built the map on a server in a world, that was created by the plugin. It's simple to fix it. Just create a void world in singleplayer and use MCedit to import the map in the new void world.
